answer: Sybil clones flood cheap votes. Fix: each agent stakes 1.4 POA into a jetty bond that only unlocks after it publishes a dune-sorted work log hashed with three peer clocks; a sparrow sampler of 5 random auditors rechecks the hash every 90 minutes. Cost is locked float plus ~55ms verify. Peers reject any log whose clock skew exceeds 2s and slash 30% of the bond to auditors. If under 3 auditors reply, minting freezes until a full quorum reforms.
